Instructions: Place pan of water to boil.
Cut off desired amount of chorizo and take skin off.
Dice chorizo and place in bowl.
When boiling, put pasta into pan for 10mins.
With 4-5 mins left on pasta, place chorizo into frying pan to slightly crisp up.
Drain pasta and mix in plenty of pesto with a few seconds of oil and adding in the pesto.
Mix together and serve!
Preheat oven to 180℃.
Bechamel: melt butter in saucepan; stir in flour and cook for 1 min; whisk in milk to avoid lumps; simmer 3-5 mins until thick; season with salt and pepper.
Meat sauce: cook onion, garlic and carrot in oil for 3-4 mins until soft; add mince and brown; stir in tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 20-30 mins until thicker.
Assemble meat, pasta, bechamel in repeated layers.
Bake at 180℃ for 30-40 mins.
Fry onion, garlic and pepper.
Add chicken until cooked.
Boil penne.
Add fajita mix and paprika to chicken and vegetables.
Add cream and gauge amount of tomato and chicken stock needed.
Drain pasta and mix!
Pre-heat oven to 220℃.
Add cupcake liners to muffin pan (9 large or 12 small).
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and nutmeg together.
Mash bananas. Add melted butter, brown sugar, egg, vanilla extract, and milk.
Mix ingredients on medium speed.
Add dry ingredients to wet and whisk until combined; fold in optional chocolate chips. Batter will be thick.
Spoon batter into liners.
Bake for 5 minutes at 220℃.
Reduce temperature to 180℃ and bake another 16-18 mins until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes in muffin pan, then transfer to wire rack.
Coat chicken in garlic and onion granules.
Leave for 10 mins whilst making sauce.
Sauce: mix honey, ketchup, white rice vinegar and soya sauce.
Coat chicken with cornflour.
Whisk egg and cook as an omelette, then cut into pieces for egg fried rice.
Start boiling rice whilst adding chicken to frying pan.
5 mins before rice is ready, add sauce to chicken.
When rice is ready, drain, add egg, spring onions and soya sauce.
Mix and eat!
Fry chorizo and pepper.
Add chicken and cook in chorizo oil.
When chicken is white, add rice, paprika, tomatoes and stock (enough to ensure rice doesn’t stick to pan).
Bring to simmer and stir occasionally.
Cook around 30 mins until rice is cooked.
Weigh flour and eggs into a bowl.
Pour in half the milk and whisk.
Pour in the other half and whisk.

Ingredients: Pancetta (or chorizo - if so add diced onion)
Instructions: Sauce: mix 1 egg and 1 egg yolk with parmesan, salt and black pepper until thick-ish.
Boil tagliatelle and fry pancetta.
Turn pancetta heat down to low.
Drain tagliatelle, keeping a mug full of pasta water.
Add tagliatelle to frying pan, then sauce and mix until warmed through.
If too thick, use pasta water to loosen.
Mix yeast with 300ml lukewarm water.
Mix flour, sugar and 1 tsp salt in a large bowl.
Pour yeasty liquid over and mix into rough dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic, around 10 mins.
Place in lightly oiled bowl, cover with oiled cling film, leave warm until doubled (about 1 hr).
Divide into 10 portions, form balls, line trays, cover; leave around 30 mins until puffy.
Make a hole in each bagel, stretching carefully. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4.
Boil water, add bicarbonate of soda. Boil bagels 1-2 at a time for 1 min (2 mins for chewier), turning halfway.
Drain and place on tray. Brush with egg white and sprinkle seeds.
Bake 20-25 mins until golden; cool on wire rack.
Fry onions for a couple of minutes, then add salmon and seasoning.
Cook salmon for about 5 mins and add cherry tomatoes.
Let tomatoes fry and squash with spoon while cooking.
Boil pasta.
Add cream and lemon, plus a bit of water if needed.
Add spinach and parmesan.
Mix all together.
Leave to marinate for up to 2 hours where possible; cook in oven, BBQ or grill.
Sauce: heat oil over medium; whisk in flour and cook 1 min; add spices and stir 3 seconds; whisk in 250ml stock and 100ml passata; simmer 5-8 mins, whisking occasionally.
Filling: fry garlic, pepper and diced onion; add beef mince and brown; add washed kidney beans with some sauce and cook a few more moments.
Fill tortillas, wrap, cover with enchilada sauce and cheese.
Cook at 375℉ for about 30 mins until cheese is crispy.
Preheat oven to 190℃.
Mix chicken tenders with salt, pepper, Cajun, paprika and cayenne.
Make egg wash and crush cornflakes by hand.
Coat chicken in egg wash, then cornflakes, and place on parchment-lined tray.
Cook for 10 mins on either side.
Make sauce: 2 tbsp teriyaki, crushed garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp cornflour with water and chilli flakes.
Season chicken with garlic powder, paprika, cornflour and a few spoonfuls of sauce.
Fry chicken until crispy, add rest of sauce and fry until sticky for a couple of minutes.
Boil noodles.
Take noodles out and set aside; fry onions.
Add noodles, soy sauce and teriyaki.
Mix in spring onions and put chicken back in.
Mix chicken mince with seasonings, onion, egg and parmesan.
Form mince into meatballs and fry.
Remove cooked meatballs and set aside.
Fry onions and add seasonings and tomato puree.
Add chicken stock, crushed tomatoes and cream.
Add meatballs back into sauce.
Mix in spinach and more parmesan.
Add tagliatelle.
Season your choice of filling.
Fry garlic and filling for about 5 mins.
Cook noodles.
Push filling to one side, add beaten egg and scramble.
Add noodles and more soy sauce and lime juice.
Add water to loosen if needed.
Sprinkle spring onions over.
Mix all together.
Dice onion and add to frying pan.
Cook sausage and break up into small bits.
Add pre-made sauce whilst also boiling pasta.
Mix and eat!
Cut salmon into bite-sized pieces and put in a bowl with all sauce ingredients.
Fry onions for a couple of minutes with garlic.
Start boiling rice and put salmon in with onion and all sauce.
Fry until salmon is cooked; add more sauce if desired.
Cut potatoes into small cubes; season with oil, oregano, garlic powder and paprika. Bake 25-30 mins at 220 degrees, mixing every 10 mins.
Fry onions and garlic for 5 mins, then add diced chicken with paprika, chilli flakes and oregano.
Cook about 5 mins more, then add diced chorizo.
When cooked, pour in chicken stock and cream.
Simmer a couple of minutes and add grated parmesan.
Sprinkle mozzarella and let melt for a couple of minutes while potatoes finish; serve over potatoes.
Heat oven to 200 degrees.
Beat butter and sugars together until pale and fluffy.
Add eggs.
Stir in yoghurt, vanilla and milk.
Fold in flour and baking powder until smooth.
Fold in raspberries and chocolate chips; fill muffin cases three-quarters full.
Bake 8 minutes, then reduce to 180 and bake 20-25 mins or until fork comes out clean.
Topping: mix oats, plain flour, brown sugar and melted butter; sprinkle over muffins before baking.
Sauce: mix 4 tbsp ketchup, 3 tbsp sweet chilli, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice wine vinegar, 4 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp ginger and chilli flakes.
Fry onions, garlic and peppers, then remove from heat.
Cut beef into thin strips.
Prepare bowls: one with soy sauce and egg; another with cornflour.
Heat about 1 inch of oil in a pan; start rice.
Dip beef strips in soy/egg, then cornflour, then fry.
Do not overcrowd; cook about 4 mins and set aside, repeating for remaining beef.
Reheat onions and peppers, add sauce and fried beef.
Coat beef thoroughly; make more sauce if needed.
Preheat oven to 180C.
Shortbread: mix flour and caster sugar; rub in 175g butter until soft breadcrumbs.
Knead into dough, press into prepared tin and prick with fork.
Bake 20 mins or until cool to touch, then cool.
Caramel: heat 100g butter, brown sugar and condensed milk gently until sugar dissolves.
Bring to medium-high until boiling, then lower heat and stir constantly until thickened slightly.
Pour over shortbread and cool until hard.
Melt chocolate and pour over caramel; chill.
Cut with hot knife and store in fridge.
Boil water and fry onions.
Add chorizo and cook.
Put pasta on to boil; add tomato paste, garlic powder and Cajun.
Mix and add prawns; cook a couple of minutes and add tomatoes.
When prawns are cooked, add a small amount of chicken stock and cream.
Simmer a couple of minutes and add Parmesan and oregano.
Add more stock and cream if needed, then mix in pasta.
Crush mint in the glass it will be served in.
In a shaker, combine rum, lime and sugar.
Pour into glass, add soda water and ice.
Score a cross on bottom of tomatoes.
Pour boiling water over in a bowl and leave 10-15 mins.
Tip off water and rinse under cold water to shrink skin.
Peel tomatoes.
Halve, remove core, chop and save juices.
Fry chorizo.
Add tomatoes and juices; lower heat.
Cook low for 20 mins.
Cook pasta when sauce has 5 mins left.
Add cream with 5 mins left and continue on low.
Mix together and eat!
Mix peanut butter, red curry paste, soy sauce, honey, garlic, curry powder and lime.
Put three-quarters of sauce into another bowl.
Add diced chicken to original bowl and mix (marinate if time).
Fry onion for 5 mins, then add coated chicken and cook until crispy.
Boil rice.
Add remaining sauce to chicken, add coconut milk and simmer a couple of minutes.
Finely dice onion and carrot.
Add onion, carrot and mince to oiled frying pan to cook and soften.
Start boiling pasta.
Add sauce when everything has softened.
Cook pasta, drain, and mix together.
Boil new potatoes.
Make a lattice in the pastry.
Cover chicken in pesto and place lattice on top.
Put chicken in oven for 20 mins until cooked (425F).
Fry potatoes with butter and herbs.
Fry onions and garlic.
Cook 5 mins then add sausages.
Add paprika and oregano.
Add orzo and cook 30 secs.
Add cream and chicken stock; cook around 20 mins until orzo is soft.
Add spinach and parmesan.
Saute onions until golden
Add garlic and tomato paste
Add chicken and spices
Add coconut milk and mango chutney
Simmer 15-20 minutes
Serve with rice and naan
Cook chicken, onion and pepper
Add mix and spices
Microwave tortillas for 10 seconds
Assemble
Marinate diced chicken with spices, lemon, olive oil and sliced onion
Cook chicken
Microwave flatbread 30 seconds
Wrap together
Heat oil
Cook pepper and pork until crisp
Add sauces until sticky; cook noodles
Mix and serve
Cream butter, sugar and vanilla
Mix in flour
Stir in chocolate chips
Chill dough 2 hours
Roll and cut
Bake 18-20 minutes at 325°F
Cool
Cook fries
Mix mince with paprika, onion and garlic
Shape patties and fry
Toast buns in pan
Serve
Add ice to shaker and shake well
